  MINUTES

  City of La Habra Heights
  Regular Meeting of the La Habra Heights Planning Commission
  March 25, 2014

Opening Ceremonies

Regular Business

1.  Call Meeting to Order— At 7: 00 p. m. Vice Chairman DiMario called the Regular
Planning Commission Meeting to order.

2.  Roll Call

Present: Vice Chairman Dominick DiMario, Commissioners Ray Fernandez, and Greg
Stefflre

Absent: Chairman Larry Black, Commissioner Ross Owen, and Alternate Eric Grimm

Also Present: David King, Planning Commission Attorney; Katherine Leazer, Principal
Planner; and Sandra Studer, Deputy City Clerk/ Records Manager

3.  Flag Salute

4.  Public Comment

Consent Calendar

Action: Moved ( Stefflre), seconded ( Fernandez), and voted 3-0 ( absent Black, Owen,
and Alternate Grimm) to approve consent agenda items 5 and 6.

5.  Minutes Of January 28, 2014— Regular Meeting

6.  Monthly Community Development Department Report

  End of Consent Calendar

Regular Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  1  March 25, 2014

Approved As Amended November 25, 2014
 Public Hearing

7.  Amendments to Articles 4, 7, 8 and 9 of the La Habra Heights Municipal
  Code
Action: Moved ( Steffire), seconded ( Fernandez), and voted 3- 0 ( absent Black, Owen
and Alternate Grimm) to send this back to the City Council as it is, unchanged, with the
additional comment that we do not see any benefit being served in having the Chairman
or any other member of the Planning Commission be a micro- reviewer of the
Administrative findings.

Staff Comments

Planning Commission Comments

Commissioner Fernandez requested and Commissioner Stefflre stated support for
placing an item on the next meeting regarding story poles.

Adjourn Meeting —At 7: 43 p. m.  Vice Chairman DiMario adjourned the meeting.

Submitted for Planning Commission Approval

Sandra$  tuder, Deputy City Clerk

Regular Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  2  March 25, 2014

Approved As Amended November 25, 2014
